## 3. Inquiry & Admission API Endpoints
- **Enquiry Endpoint:** `POST https://api.sssamacademy.com/api/enquiry`
- **Content-Type:** `application/json`
- **Request Body Fields:**
  - `fullName` (string, required): Full Name of applicant
  - `phoneNumber` (string, 10 digits, required): Mobile number
  - `course` (string, required): Course name or "Others"
  - `customCourseName` (string, optional): Custom course title if course is "Others"
  - `email` (string, optional): Email address
